path_placeholders.${ASSETS}: external GGUF, pack and MTP directory

hash_scope: Hashes inside copied artifacts refer to the original records. This manifest records original and exported byte hashes. Absolute path prefixes are replaced and JSON layout is compacted; no JSON values are otherwise changed. Compressed logs/fixtures are lossless after the stated path substitution.
excluded: weights, binaries, raw tensors/logits, profiler CSV, build logs, raw process maps and resource streams
